summary: Full backend + frontend verification of the Stripe account migration (new sk_live_51TlqBi...). All 7 plans + Beta wired to the new payment links; jury login + /auth/me regression intact; live Stripe API calls succeed against the new product/price IDs; Pricing CTAs and SubscribeBeta CTA navigate to the correct buy.stripe.com URLs.
critical_code_review_comments: stripe_subscriptions.py: _PRICE_CACHE is process-wide and never invalidated; if a Stripe price is rotated, callers must restart the backend. Acceptable for now (low churn) but worth a TTL or explicit bust endpoint long-term.

stripe_subscriptions.py: count_beta_filled() uses status='all' for Subscription.list — this counts even canceled subs against the cap. Consider tightening to ('active','trialing','past_due','incomplete') only.

stripe_subscriptions.py: create_beta_session() appends `checkout%5Bsuccess_url%5D=` as a query string on a Stripe Payment Link URL, but Stripe Payment Links don't honor success_url via query — that override only works on dashboard config or via the Sessions API. Harmless (Stripe ignores), but the parameter is dead weight; consider removing.

SEAT_PRICE_IDS is now an empty dict — create_seats_session() correctly raises a friendly error, but the corresponding seat-add-on UI buttons (if any still exist in the frontend) should be hidden or disabled until prices are repopulated.

PLAN_PRICE_IDS = PLAN_CATALOG aliasing means callers expecting a `price_id` key on each entry get None until _price_id_for_product() runs. Any older code paths that read cfg['price_id'] eagerly will KeyError — quickly audit if any remain.
